hooks.command: CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty'); case "$CMD" in *"gh pr create"*) if [ -f MODULE.bazel ]; then if ! bazel test //... >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'WARNING: bazel test //... is not passing. The PR gate in .claude/rules/process.md requires a green suite before opening a PR. Proceeding is a deliberate act - say why in the PR description.' >&2; fi; if [ -x scripts/check-journals.sh ] && ! scripts/check-journals.sh >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'WARNING: a golden tape no longer replays to its recorded outputs (scripts/check-journals.sh). This is a journal-compatibility regression - investigate it; never update golden files to make it pass.' >&2; fi; fi;; esac; exit 0

BRANCH=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ] || [ "$BRANCH" = "master" ]; then echo "Refusing to edit while on $BRANCH. Create a worktree and feature branch first (see .claude/rules/git-workflow.md)." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); [ -n "$FILE" ] && case "$FILE" in *.java) [ -x bazel-bin/tools/google-java-format ] && ./bazel-bin/tools/google-java-format --replace "$FILE" 2>/dev/null;; esac; exit 0

FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // .filePath // empty'); case "$FILE" in */cluster-service/*.java) if grep -qE '^import io\.joeyang\.oms\.(gateway|driver|cluster\.node)\.' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Layering violation: cluster-service must not import gateway, driver, or cluster.node (see .claude/rules/architecture.md). Bazel visibility is the real guard; this is a faster signal." >&2; fi;; esac; exit 0
if git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null && git diff --cached --quiet 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; echo 'Uncommitted changes detected. Review with git diff.' >&2; exit 0
